summary: Confirmed 50 A/water/sewer and reservable; count 24->23 (group G-1 excluded), max_rig 98->68 (98 was not an RV length), pull-through added (site 25); fees 22-22 -> 22-24; facilities and 14-night max added; not waterfront kept; pin fine.
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. Esri 2026-11-06 with catalog coordinates: the nearest sites (25, 26, 10) sit ~60-120 m from Big Hill Lake through continuous dense oak-hickory woods; rec.gov: 'the lake is only a short walk away from the campsites'. No view earned.

PIN 37.2803,-95.4717 is at the catalog site centroid (37.28034,-95.47174); fine.
